Authored GitHub Actions service credentials mapping entry; expression values are preserved as source config and not evaluated.

gaps: matrix, strategy, job outputs, container/service config and expression values are indexed as authored policy/config evidence but are not evaluated or expanded into runtime jobs
reusable workflow targets and action refs are materialized from authored uses fields; remote content/availability and expression-derived targets require external/runtime evidence
